bear_assumptions: USD 10 normalized EPS at 26x as AI competition, antitrust remedies, capital-spending pressure and dilution slow per-share growth and compress the multiple.
base_assumptions: USD 12 normalized EPS at 30x as Search remains resilient, Cloud scales, operating margins stay strong and elevated infrastructure spending earns adequate but not exceptional incremental returns.
bull_assumptions: USD 15 normalized EPS at 32x as AI products expand Search usage, Cloud growth remains unusually strong, margins improve and infrastructure investment converts into durable per-share cash flow.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh mark restores the required confidence-adjusted expected return, base upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, and margin of safety while Search and Cloud growth, AI monetization, operating margins and per-share cash conversion remain supported; downgrade on sustained Search share loss, Cloud deceleration or margin weakness, infrastructure spending that persistently suppresses free cash flow, material dilution without commensurate returns, or antitrust remedies that impair distribution or monetization.
